Stored x1,000 in KES. Net change in cash for FY2025 is 373,762 = 379,618 increase less the 5,856 exchange effect, the same basis the file already uses for FY2024 to FY2021 where the three totals plus the exchange effect reproduce the stored movement exactly. Capital expenditure and free cash flow are left empty for FY2025 because the summary prints no property, plant and equipment purchases line. The earlier Cash used in Investing/Financing Activities (total) rows held component sums (capex only, and dividends received under financing) and are corrected to the printed net figures.
